panels.title: ℹ️  Dashboard Info — datasource, endpoint & what you're looking at
About — where this data comes from

options.content:
| | |
|---|---|
| **Project** | WSL Proxy (OpenResty API gateway / reverse proxy) |
| **Dashboard** | SRE — 10 Layers (`uid: wslproxy-sre`) |
| **Datasource** | `${datasource}` (Prometheus — PromQL API) |
| **Metrics endpoint** | https://prod-our.wslproxy.com/metrics |
| **Exporter** | OpenResty `lua-prometheus` (embedded in nginx) |
| **Collected by** | Prometheus scraping `/metrics` every 30s → this Grafana |
| **Scrape config** | `dashboard/prometheus/scrape/scrape-config.yaml` (one job per env) |
| **SLO target** | 99.9% availability (error budget 0.1%) |

**You are currently viewing:**

| Scope | Value |
|---|---|
| 🌍 Environment | **${env:text}** |
| 🖥️ Instance(s) | **${instance:text}** |
| 🔗 Host / vHost | **${host:text}** |
| 🗄️ Datasource | **${datasource:text}** |

_“All” = every scraped target aggregated. Change these with the variables at the very top of the dashboard. Data flows: **client → WSL Proxy (this env) → `/metrics` → Prometheus → Grafana**._

panels.title: Scrape Targets (data sources feeding this dashboard)
panels.description: Every Prometheus target scraped for WSL Proxy. `Env`/`Region`/`Job`/`Instance` come from scrape-config.yaml labels and tell you exactly which environment / node each metric originates from. Up=1 (green) means that source is currently reporting.

options.content: Top-down: start at **Layer 1 (SLO)** and only descend when a golden signal turns yellow/red. **1** SLO summary · **2** Edge · **3** Traffic · **4** Errors · **5** Latency · **6** Routing · **7** Backends · **8** Saturation · **9** Cache · **10** Security & observability.

panels.title: Active vHosts
panels.description: Distinct proxied hosts seen in the current scope

panels.title: Error-Budget Burn Rate (99.9% SLO)
panels.description: 5xx ratio ÷ error budget (0.1%), 5m window. >1 = burning budget faster than allowed; >10 = fast-burn, page-worthy. Multi-window burn alerts ship in prometheus/rules/sre-rules.yaml.

panels.title: Active Connections
panels.description: SATURATION golden signal — reading+writing+waiting (the exporter emits no separate 'active' state)

panels.title: Edge & Proxy Latency (p95)
panels.description: Compare the three layers to localise where latency is added

panels.title: Active Connections
panels.description: Total in-flight connections = reading+writing+waiting (nginx emits no separate 'active' gauge)

panels.title: Metric Emit Errors
panels.description: lua-prometheus internal errors — non-zero means dropped metrics

panels.title: Cache Hit Ratio by Host
panels.description: Note: this is the SRE summary view — see the dedicated 'WSL Proxy - Cache' dashboard for per-extension, stores and content-type detail.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (host) (rate(nginx_cache_hits_total{env=~"$env"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (host) (rate(nginx_cache_hits_total{env=~"$env"}[5m])) + sum by (host) (rate(nginx_cache_misses_total{env=~"$env"}[5m])), 0.0001)

panels.title: WAF Inspection p95 (s)
panels.description: Populates when WAF body inspection runs; empty if no policy is inspecting bodies

options.content:
**Scrape health** is below. `up` / `scrape_*` are synthesised by the scraping Prometheus, not by the endpoint.

**Not exported** by lua-prometheus (so not shown): `go_*`, `process_*` (CPU/RSS/FD), cache size/evictions, health-check duration. Saturation uses connection state + metric-emit errors as the closest real signals.

Companion dashboards: **WSL Proxy - Backend Health** and **WSL Proxy - Cache**.
